FullCalendar v6.1.19 (MIT)
https://github.com/fullcalendar/fullcalendar
Vendored for the no-build frontend. Styles are extracted into fullcalendar.css and linked from index.html.
The global bundle's startup style injection is disabled (void 0 instead of _e(document), and Te returns when the stylesheet is blocked) because style-src 'self' rejects the injected style tag and that rejection throws before FullCalendar is defined.
